notes:
Quick, choppy CRM notes from discovery.
- Company: early-stage SMB building a sales enablement tool (meeting recaps + playbook generation).
- Primary ask: hosted API (self-serve), want fast time-to-value; public cloud (AWS us-east-1 preferred).
- Data sensitivity: heavy — transcripts can include customer PII (emails, phone numbers, occasional SSN-like sequences). CTO said: "We can't store raw transcripts longer than 7 days without explicit consent." Wants default TTL on stored artifacts.
- Technical asks: endpoint-level retention TTL, per-customer opt-out for logging, server-side regex-based PII redaction, KMS integration for envelope encryption, request/response audit logs (readable by security team), ability to scrub logs via API.
- Business ask: clear pricing for embeddings + generation; metric correlation for cost per minute of transcription / token; want sample DPA & data flow to share with legal.
- Preferred flow: self-serve signup -> try Hosted API -> if usage hits X then consider Dedicated. Current plan: start with hosted, may convert in 6-12 months.
- Quote from PM: "Easy signup + transparent retention controls is a must. If Redwood can show how we can avoid storing sensitive fields it speeds legal sign-off."
- Quick links: pricing deck + security questions uploaded to Drive (see linked_drive_docs), Gmail thread for SSO & account setup (thread-1782938475).
- Internal notes: low-touch sales motion. Provide a one-pager on PII handling, example API calls showing redaction, and a short video walkthrough of retention settings.
